function.description: Get field notice affecting the network device by device Id and notice id
function.name: api_getFieldNoticeAffectingTheNetworkDeviceByDeviceIdAndNoticeId

deviceCount.description: Number of devices which are vulnerable to this field notice

firstPublishDate.description: Time at which the field notice was published

lastUpdatedDate.description: Time at which the field notice was last updated

matchConfidence.description: 'VULNERABLE' - network device is vulnerable to the field notice. 'POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE' - network device is potentially vulnerable to the field notice. additional manual verifications are needed.

matchReason.description: If the MatchConfidence is POTENTIALLY_VULNERABLE, this gives more details such as what was matched and if additional manual verifications are needed.

potentialDeviceCount.description: Number of devices which are potentially vulnerable to this field notice

publicationUrl.description: Url for getting field notice details on cisco website

type.description: 'SOFTWARE' - field notice is for the network device software. 'HARDWARE' - field notice is for the network device hardware
